> \(b\) the fifth (5th) anniversary of the Effective Date; or
>
> \(c\) such later date as may be approved by the Bankruptcy Court upon motion by the Litigation Trustee, showing good cause for an extension of the term of the Litigation Trust, including the existence of pending litigation or other matters that cannot reasonably be concluded prior to the fifth anniversary.

Consistent with the purpose of the Litigation Trust as a liquidating trust, the Litigation Trustee shall not unduly prolong the existence of the Litigation Trust beyond the time reasonably necessary to liquidate the Litigation Trust Assets and make final distributions to the Beneficiaries. The Litigation Trustee shall use reasonable efforts to conclude the affairs of the Litigation Trust as expeditiously as is consistent with maximizing recoveries for the Beneficiaries.

**Section 10.02 --- Final Distribution and Termination**

Prior to the termination and dissolution of the Litigation Trust, the Litigation Trustee shall: (a) complete all pending litigation, settlements, and collections, or abandon any remaining claims with insufficient value to justify further prosecution; (b) pay all outstanding expenses and obligations of the Litigation Trust; and (c) make a final distribution of all remaining Litigation Trust Assets to the Beneficiaries on a pro rata basis.

The Litigation Trustee shall file a final report and accounting with the Bankruptcy Court and shall provide copies thereof to all Beneficiaries and to the Reorganized Debtor. The final report shall include a comprehensive summary of all receipts, disbursements, distributions, litigation outcomes, and other material activities of the Litigation Trust throughout its term.

Upon the completion of all distributions, the filing of all required tax returns, and the filing of the final report and accounting with the Bankruptcy Court, the Litigation Trust shall be deemed dissolved and the Litigation Trustee shall be deemed discharged from all further duties and obligations hereunder, except for obligations that by their terms survive termination of this Agreement.

**[ARTICLE XI --- MISCELLANEOUS PROVISIONS]{.underline}**

**Section 11.01 --- Amendments**

This Agreement may be amended, modified, or supplemented only by a written instrument duly executed by the Litigation Trustee and approved in writing by the Trust Advisory Board. Any material amendment to this Agreement --- including, without limitation, any amendment that would alter the rights of the Beneficiaries, change the distribution provisions, or modify the purpose or duration of the Litigation Trust --- shall require the prior approval of the Bankruptcy Court after notice and a hearing.

No amendment to this Agreement shall alter the purpose of the Litigation Trust from a liquidating trust to an entity engaged in the conduct of a trade or business, or shall otherwise cause the Litigation Trust to fail to qualify as a liquidating trust under Treasury Regulation Section 301.7701-4(d) or as a grantor trust under Sections 671 through 679 of the IRC.

**Section 11.02 --- Notices**

All notices, requests, demands, consents, waivers, and other communications required or permitted under this Agreement shall be in writing and shall be deemed duly given and received: (a) upon personal delivery; (b) one (1) Business Day after deposit with a nationally recognized overnight courier service, with delivery charges prepaid; or (c) three (3) Business Days after mailing by United States certified mail, return receipt requested, postage prepaid, in each case addressed as follows:

**Section 11.03 --- No Recourse**

No Beneficiary shall have any recourse against, or right to recover from, any individual member of the Trust Advisory Board, the Litigation Trustee (except as expressly provided in Article IX hereof and Section 3.03 hereof), the Debtor, the Reorganized Debtor, or any of their respective directors, officers, employees, agents, or representatives, in their individual capacities, in connection with any matter arising out of or related to the Litigation Trust or this Agreement, except as expressly provided herein.

**Section 11.04 --- Severability**

If any provision of this Agreement is held to be invalid, illegal, void, or unenforceable by any court of competent jurisdiction, such holding shall not affect, impair, or invalidate the remaining provisions hereof, all of which shall remain in full force and effect. In the event that any provision is so held to be invalid, illegal, void, or unenforceable, the Parties shall negotiate in good faith to amend this Agreement to give effect, to the maximum extent possible, to the original intent of the Parties as reflected in the provision held to be invalid.

**Section 11.05 --- Entire Agreement**

This Agreement, together with the Plan, the Confirmation Order, and all exhibits and schedules hereto and thereto, constitutes the entire agreement among the Parties with respect to the subject matter hereof and supersedes all prior negotiations, understandings, and agreements, whether oral or written, relating to the Litigation Trust. In the event of any inconsistency or conflict between this Agreement and the Plan, the Plan shall govern and control. In the event of any inconsistency or conflict between this Agreement and the Confirmation Order, the Confirmation Order shall govern and control.

**Section 11.06 --- Counterparts; Electronic Signatures**

This Agreement may be executed in any number of counterparts, each of which shall be deemed to be an original and all of which, taken together, shall constitute one and the same instrument. Delivery of an executed counterpart of a signature page to this Agreement by facsimile, portable document format (.pdf), or other electronic transmission shall be as effective as delivery of an original executed counterpart.

**Section 11.07 --- Retention of Jurisdiction**

The Bankruptcy Court shall retain exclusive jurisdiction over the following matters to the fullest extent permitted by applicable law, including 28 U.S.C. §§ 157 and 1334:

> \(a\) all disputes, controversies, and matters arising under or in connection with this Agreement, including the interpretation and enforcement of any provision hereof;
>
> \(b\) the Litigation Trustee\'s exercise of the powers and duties set forth in this Agreement;
>
> \(c\) the approval of settlements of Assigned Causes of Action exceeding Two Million Dollars (\$2,000,000), as required by Section 5.03(c) hereof;
>
> \(d\) the review and approval of the Litigation Trustee\'s final report and accounting;
>
> \(e\) the removal, resignation, or replacement of the Litigation Trustee or any member of the Trust Advisory Board;
>
> \(f\) the allowance, estimation, or disallowance of disputed General Unsecured Claims in Class 5 for purposes of determining Litigation Trust Interests and distributions;
>
> \(g\) the amendment of this Agreement, to the extent Bankruptcy Court approval is required under Section 11.01; and
>
> \(h\) any other matter arising out of or related to the Litigation Trust that the Bankruptcy Court determines is within its jurisdiction.

Notwithstanding the foregoing, nothing in this Section 11.07 shall be construed to limit the Litigation Trustee\'s right to commence and prosecute the Assigned Causes of Action in any court of competent jurisdiction, including state courts and federal courts other than the Bankruptcy Court, as the Litigation Trustee deems appropriate in the exercise of reasonable business judgment.

**Section 11.08 --- Relationship to Plan and Confirmation Order**

This Agreement is entered into pursuant to and consistent with the Plan and the Confirmation Order. The Parties acknowledge and agree that this Agreement is an integral component of the Plan and is intended to implement the provisions of Article VII of the Plan relating to the Litigation Trust. In the event of any inconsistency or conflict between this Agreement and the Plan, the terms of the Plan shall control. In the event of any inconsistency or conflict between this Agreement and the Confirmation Order, the terms of the Confirmation Order shall control.

The Parties specifically incorporate by reference the following provisions of the Plan: Article VII (Litigation Trust Provisions), Article IX (Conditions Precedent to the Effective Date), and Article XI (Retention of Jurisdiction). import re

from docx.shared import Pt, Inches, RGBColor

from docx.enum.text import WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH
from docx.enum.table import WD_TABLE_ALIGNMENT

NAVY = "1F3864"
RAG = {"RED": "F4B6B6", "AMBER": "FFE699", "GREEN": "C6EFCE", "GREY": "D9D9D9"}

def shade(cell, hexcolor):
    tcPr = cell._tc.get_or_add_tcPr()
    for old in tcPr.findall(qn("w:shd")):
        tcPr.remove(old)
    shd = OxmlElement("w:shd")
    shd.set(qn("w:val"), "clear")
    shd.set(qn("w:color"), "auto")
    shd.set(qn("w:fill"), hexcolor)
    tcPr.append(shd)

def add_runs(p, text, size=None, color=None, italic=False):
    parts = re.split(r"(\*\*.+?\*\*)", text)
    for part in parts:
        if not part:
            continue
        bold = part.startswith("**") and part.endswith("**")
        t = part[2:-2] if bold else part
        r = p.add_run(t)
        r.bold = bold
        r.italic = italic
        if size:
            r.font.size = Pt(size)
        if color:
            r.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(color)
    return p

def para(doc, text, size=10, style=None, italic=False, space_after=4, align=None, color=None):
    p = doc.add_paragraph(style=style) if style else doc.add_paragraph()
    add_runs(p, text, size=size, italic=italic, color=color)
    p.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(space_after)
    if align == "center":
        p.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER
    return p

def bullet(doc, text, size=10, level=0):
    p = doc.add_paragraph(style="List Bullet" if level == 0 else "List Bullet 2")
    add_runs(p, text, size=size)
    p.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(2)
    return p

def numbered(doc, text, size=10):
    p = doc.add_paragraph(style="List Number")
    add_runs(p, text, size=size)
    p.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(2)
    return p

def heading(doc, text, level=1):
    h = doc.add_heading(text, level=level)
    for r in h.runs:
        r.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(NAVY)
    return h

def set_repeat_header(row):
    trPr = row._tr.get_or_add_trPr()
    el = OxmlElement("w:tblHeader")
    el.set(qn("w:val"), "true")
    trPr.append(el)

def table(doc, headers, rows, widths, size=8, rag_col=None, first_col_bold=False):
    t = doc.add_table(rows=1, cols=len(headers))
    t.style = "Table Grid"
    t.alignment = WD_TABLE_ALIGNMENT.CENTER
    t.autofit = False
    hdr = t.rows[0]
    set_repeat_header(hdr)
    for i, h in enumerate(headers):
        c = hdr.cells[i]
        c.text = ""
        p = c.paragraphs[0]
        r = p.add_run(h)
        r.bold = True
        r.font.size = Pt(size)
        r.font.color.rgb = RGBColor(0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF)
        shade(c, NAVY)
    for row in rows:
        cells = t.add_row().cells
        for i, val in enumerate(row):
            c = cells[i]
            c.text = ""
            lines = str(val).split("\n")
            for j, line in enumerate(lines):
                p = c.paragraphs[0] if j == 0 else c.add_paragraph()
                txt = line
                if first_col_bold and i == 0 and not txt.startswith("**"):
                    txt = "**" + txt + "**" if txt else txt
                add_runs(p, txt, size=size)
                p.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(1)
            if rag_col is not None and i == rag_col:
                key = str(val).split()[0].upper() if str(val).strip() else ""
                if key in RAG:
                    shade(c, RAG[key])
    for row in t.rows:
        for i, w in enumerate(widths):
            row.cells[i].width = Inches(w)
    # tblGrid widths
    grid = t._tbl.tblGrid
    for i, gc in enumerate(grid.findall(qn("w:gridCol"))):
        gc.set(qn("w:w"), str(int(widths[i] * 1440)))
    doc.add_paragraph().paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(2)
    return t

def add_page_number(paragraph):
    run = paragraph.add_run()
    f1 = OxmlElement("w:fldChar"); f1.set(qn("w:fldCharType"), "begin")
    it = OxmlElement("w:instrText"); it.set(qn("xml:space"), "preserve"); it.text = "PAGE"
    f2 = OxmlElement("w:fldChar"); f2.set(qn("w:fldCharType"), "end")
    run._r.append(f1); run._r.append(it); run._r.append(f2)
    run.font.size = Pt(8)

    sec.orientation = WD_ORIENT.LANDSCAPE
    sec.page_width, sec.page_height = Inches(11), Inches(8.5)
    for m in ("left_margin", "right_margin"):
        setattr(sec, m, Inches(0.6))
    sec.top_margin = Inches(0.6); sec.bottom_margin = Inches(0.6)
    st = doc.styles["Normal"]

    hp = sec.header.paragraphs[0]
    add_runs(hp, "PRIVILEGED & CONFIDENTIAL | ATTORNEY-CLIENT COMMUNICATION / ATTORNEY WORK PRODUCT | DRAFT FOR DEAL-TEAM DISCUSSION", size=7, color="7F7F7F")
    hp.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER
    fp = sec.footer.paragraphs[0]
    add_runs(fp, "In re Oakvale Industrial Holdings, Inc., Case No. 24-10387-KBO (Bankr. D. Del.) | Effective Date Conditions Checklist | Page ", size=8, color="7F7F7F")
    add_page_number(fp)
    fp.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER
    return doc

    t = doc.add_table(rows=1, cols=len(headers))
    t.style = "Table Grid"
    t.alignment = WD_TABLE_ALIGNMENT.CENTER
    t.autofit = False
    hdr = t.rows[0]
    set_repeat_header(hdr)
    for i, h in enumerate(headers):
        c = hdr.cells[i]
        c.text = ""
        p = c.paragraphs[0]
        r = p.add_run(h)
        r.bold = True
        r.font.size = Pt(size)
        r.font.color.rgb = RGBColor(0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF)
        shade(c, NAVY)
    for row in rows:
        cells = t.add_row().cells
        for i, val in enumerate(row):
            c = cells[i]
            c.text = ""
            lines = str(val).split("\n")
            for j, line in enumerate(lines):
                p = c.paragraphs[0] if j == 0 else c.add_paragraph()
                txt = line
                if first_col_bold and i == 0 and not txt.startswith("**"):
                    txt = "**" + txt + "**" if txt else txt
                add_runs(p, txt, size=size)
                p.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(1)
            if rag_col is not None and i == rag_col:
                key = str(val).split()[0].upper() if str(val).strip() else ""
                if key in RAG:
                    shade(c, RAG[key])
    for row in t.rows:
        for i, w in enumerate(widths):
            row.cells[i].width = Inches(w)
    # tblGrid widths
    grid = t._tbl.tblGrid
    for i, gc in enumerate(grid.findall(qn("w:gridCol"))):
        gc.set(qn("w:w"), str(int(widths[i] * 1440)))
    doc.add_paragraph().paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(2)
    return t

def add_page_number(paragraph):
    run = paragraph.add_run()
    f1 = OxmlElement("w:fldChar"); f1.set(qn("w:fldCharType"), "begin")
    it = OxmlElement("w:instrText"); it.set(qn("xml:space"), "preserve"); it.text = "PAGE"
    f2 = OxmlElement("w:fldChar"); f2.set(qn("w:fldCharType"), "end")
    run._r.append(f1); run._r.append(it); run._r.append(f2)
    run.font.size = Pt(8)

def new_doc():
    doc = Document()
    sec = doc.sections[0]
    sec.orientation = WD_ORIENT.LANDSCAPE
    sec.page_width, sec.page_height = Inches(11), Inches(8.5)
    for m in ("left_margin", "right_margin"):
        setattr(sec, m, Inches(0.6))
    sec.top_margin = Inches(0.6); sec.bottom_margin = Inches(0.6)
    st = doc.styles["Normal"]
    st.font.name = "Calibri"; st.font.size = Pt(10)
    hp = sec.header.paragraphs[0]
    add_runs(hp, "PRIVILEGED & CONFIDENTIAL | ATTORNEY-CLIENT COMMUNICATION / ATTORNEY WORK PRODUCT | DRAFT FOR DEAL-TEAM DISCUSSION", size=7, color="7F7F7F")
    hp.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER
    fp = sec.footer.paragraphs[0]
    add_runs(fp, "In re Oakvale Industrial Holdings, Inc., Case No. 24-10387-KBO (Bankr. D. Del.) | Effective Date Conditions Checklist | Page ", size=8, color="7F7F7F")
    add_page_number(fp)
    fp.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER
    return doc
EOF

I've written the checklist with its status dashboard as `effective-date-checklist.docx` (19 landscape pages). It passes the docx skill's validate.py, and I parsed it back to confirm it opens. It works from the record as of February 7, 2025 (the Debtor's status report, the February 6 e-mail thread and the cure schedule). I read all 8 documents in full first.

**Bottom line:** the February 18, 2025 target Effective Date is at serious risk. Of the 18 tracked items (the 13 Plan § 9.01 conditions plus 5 more from the Confirmation Order and the exit loan commitment letter), 4 are RED, 10 AMBER and 4 GREEN. Only § 9.01(a), finality of the Confirmation Order, looks satisfied, and that still needs a docket check. The Debtor's February 7 status report says every condition is on track; the documents don't support that, and the report misnumbers or leaves out several conditions.

**The four RED items:**
- **Exit financing (§ 9.01(b), not waivable under the Plan):** the intercreditor agreement is stuck on four business points, and the ABL credit agreement has two open points. Greystone needs agreed final form by February 11.
- **Kepler cure dispute (§ 9.01(h)):** $500,000 offered against $780,000 claimed. The Confirmation Order allows no carve-out, and its own procedure can't produce a ruling before February 18. The checklist sets out settlement, escrow and waiver options.
- **Litigation Trust (§ 9.01(g)):** the agreement is still a draft, Judge Vincenzo hasn't returned his signed acceptance, and the draft conflicts with the Plan in several places, including the scope of claims transferred to the trust and who sits on its advisory board.
- **DNREC environmental permits (§ 9.01(j)):** the Debtor hasn't yet decided whether a change-of-control notice is needed. The permits named in the status report don't match the ones defined in the Plan.

**Problems the existing documents miss:**
- **Deadlines are a day off.** February 17 is Presidents' Day, a bank holiday, so the "3 Business Days before" deadline for signing the exit loan documents is February 12, not the February 13 stated everywhere. The board designation deadline is February 10.
- **Effective Date definition.** The Plan sets the Effective Date as the first Business Day *after* all conditions are met. A same-day closing on February 18 therefore needs written consent from the required first lien lenders under Confirmation Order ¶ 31.
- **No shares left for warrants or management equity.** The new charter authorizes 10,000,000 common shares and all of them are issued on the Effective Date, so there is no room for the 500,000 warrant shares or the 8% management incentive pool.
- **The Confirmation Order is stricter than the Plan in places.**
  - The Shareholders' Agreement must be signed "by or on behalf of all holders," not just the company.
  - It adds four conditions of its own: trust funding, KERP payments, U.S. Trustee fees, and no stay of the order.
  - The Outside Date can be extended only by court order, not by agreement.
- **Inconsistent names across documents.** The Debtor appears as both "Oakvale" and "Ridgemont," which matters for the charter filing and lien perfection. Committee counsel is named three different ways.
- **The status report's cash figure is short.** It shows $54.15M and omits the $250,000 U.S. Trustee fees; with Kepler's full claim the planning figure is $54.68M.
- **KERP forfeiture terms differ** among the KERP order, the Plan and the Confirmation Order.

Beyond the dashboard and the condition-by-condition analysis, the document includes:
- a key-dates calendar;
- a tracker for the lenders' closing deliverables;
- a day-by-day critical path to February 18;
- a cash reconciliation;
- a waiver and consent matrix;
- a log of 21 inconsistencies between the documents;
- a contingency plan if the date slips;
- post-closing deadlines and open information requests.

- effective-date-checklist.docx
